A '''Gank bounty hunter''' captured the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Kaj Nedmak]] after being hired by fellow [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Thune (bounty hunter)|Thune]]. The [[Gank/Legends|Gank]] transported the captive to meet Thune in a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. There, a standoff occurred between the Gank and Thune and Thune's own captives, the Humans [[Celia Durasha]] and [[Treytis Prash]]. The Gank's prisoner overpowered his captor, and Durasha killed the bounty hunter.
